messages:
Mia Chen: FYI rolling v3.4.1 to production now. Deploy bot reports a slight p95 uptick in USW after canary ~2m ago. keeping an eye.
Alex Rivera: saw the delta, ~120ms shift on p95 for text-gen path. Not massive but above our canary threshold.
Jamal Patel: deploy-bot flagged 2.5% error increase on embed route as well. screenshot -> https://img.redwood/logs/6312345
deploy-bot: AUTOSAFETY: p95_latency > threshold AND error_rate > threshold -> recommend: hold rollout, consider manual rollback. (reason: KV cache mismatch suspected) :warning:
Mia Chen: holding traffic now. Can someone confirm whether this is model variant or infra?
Sophia Li: infra metrics look fine (GPU util stable, no OOM). Early signal points to kvcache miss after the operator patch.
Alex Rivera: agree with Sophia. kvcache keys differ between 3.4.0 and 3.4.1 due to serialization change. That explains small latency spike + 429s from cache misses.
Jamal Patel: propose manual rollback to v3.4.0 for USW only, keep remaining regions running. We should avoid global revert unless customer-facing impact widens.
Mia Chen: +1. What's the quick rollback command and comms text?
Alex Rivera: rollback command (can run from release-ops):
```
# pin traffic back to v3.4.0 for USW
releasectl traffic shift --region=us-west --from=3.4.1 --to=3.4.0 --weight=100 --reason="kvcache-serialization-regression"
```
Run with `--dry-run` first, then execute.
Sophia Li: runbook checklist: 1) set traffic slice to 0 for canary, 2) pin v3.4.0 for USW, 3) monitor p95 & errors for 10m, 4) if OK, unpin and re-release after a patch.
Mia Chen: draft customer-facing blurb: "We briefly rolled out v3.4.1 to a subset of users in US-West. We observed elevated latency for some requests and reverted that region to v3.4.0 while we investigate. No data loss. Full rollout paused. We'll share follow-up in 30–60m." Thoughts? :thumbsup:
Jamal Patel: that's good. Add contact for enterprise customers: support@redwood.ai and link to status page.
deploy-bot: SUGGESTION: automatic fallback available if threshold exceeded for 3 consecutive evaluation windows. Current windows: 2/5 triggered. Manual override required to complete rollback.
Mia Chen: OK Jamal, Alex — please run the dry-run now, and if it looks correct, execute. I'll post the customer blurb to #status-updates and notify accounts with active Dedicated contracts.
Alex Rivera: dry-run output looks clean. no unexpected services affected. executing now.
Alex Rivera: executed. traffic shift at 6312345789. monitoring p95 and errors.
ops-bot: ALERT: USW p95 back to baseline in 3m. error rate normalized.
Mia Chen: Great. I'll send the short note and mark the rollout paused in the release doc. Action items: Alex follow up with a patch to restore kvcache compatibility, Sophia to prepare regression test, Jamal to draft customer follow-up.
Jamal Patel: putting items in the release ticket now.
Sophia Li: I'll add a unit test for serialization and add an integration test that hits the live kvcache in staging.
Mia Chen: thanks team. We'll reconvene in 45m unless anything else pops. :coffee:
